verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDK support across 'over a dozen platforms' and provides a concrete GitHub example (rollbar.js) with documented features like telemetry, search, and session replay, showing real, maintained official SDKs an AI-native developer could integrate against. Missing for 10: a full list/repo evidence for all supported language SDKs, explicit versioning/release notes, and independent corroboration beyond one repo.
